Own app/notifierd.py (service entrypoint per the boot contract: python -m app.notifierd --db-dir P --port M, listening within 10s of process start; booted alone or via the wrapper owned by the core slice) and app/notify_store.py (durable store under --db-dir for processed events and notifications). Implements POST /notify/events accepting {events:[...]} and returning {accepted:[seq...], duplicate:[seq...]} — idempotent so ledgerd's at-least-once outbox relay never double-applies; GET /health returning {status:'ok', received, applied, duplicate, notifications}; GET /notify/processed?after=<seq> returning {processed:[{seq,type}...], latest_seq} and staying durable across restarts; GET /notify/notifications?limit=&offset= returning {data:[{id,event_seq,kind,message,at}...], total} newest first. Cross-refs: receives batches of at most 50 ascending seq from the outbox relay owned by the core slice; ledgerd's /api/notifications proxy (owned by the api slice) forwards to this service and expects a clean failure signal when it is unreachable.
